NONE: A2 used when the subject of the verb is "I" and the object is the same person
（反身代詞）我自己
B2 used to emphasize "I" as the subject of a sentence
（用於強調主語）我自己，我本人
› used instead of "I" or "me"
（用於代替Ｉ或 me）我
› alone or without help from anyone else
單獨；獨自
› for my use only
只屬於自己的
› not to be, seem, or feel as happy or as healthy as usual
感覺自己身體不適
› UK informal used when describing your state of mind when you are physically ill
（用於身體不適時指自己的精神狀態）

example: I bought myself a new coat.
我為自己買了一件新外套。
I caught sight of myself in the mirror.
我在鏡子中看見了自己。
Yes, I thought to myself, it's time to take a holiday.
是啊，我自己思忖著，是時候去休假了。
I myself don't like a heavy meal at lunchtime.
我本人不喜歡午餐時吃很多。
I don't like a heavy meal at lunchtime myself.
我自己不喜歡午餐時吃很多。
My husband and myself were delighted with the gift.
我和丈夫收到這份禮物都很高興。
They very kindly invited my sister and myself to the inauguration.
他們盛情邀請我和姐姐參加開幕式。
(all) by myself
我自己一個人住。
I never get an hour to myself.
我從沒有屬於自己的一個小時的時間。
I went to see the doctor because I haven't been feeling myself lately.
我最近覺得身體不適，去看了病。
I'm well enough in myself (= happy) - I've just got this nagging headache.
我精神狀態很好——只是這頭痛的毛病一直沒好。

NONE: › the name of a social media website used especially for sharing music, music videos, and information about musical artists
聚友網（一個供人們透過部落格、照片和影片分享個人資訊的網站）
B2 strange, not known, or not understood
神秘的事物，難以理解的事物，謎

example: She's an actress whose inner life has remained mysterious, despite the many interviews she has given.
作為一名演員，她雖然接受過多次採訪，但私生活依然很神秘。
He died in mysterious circumstances, and there is still a possibility that it was murder.
他死得蹊蹺，仍不排除是謀殺的可能。

C or U: B1 [ C or U ] something strange or not known that has not yet been explained or understood
神秘的事物，難以理解的事物，謎

C: › [ C ] a book, film, or play, especially about a crime or a murder, with a surprise ending that explains all the strange events that have happened
懸疑作品；懸疑電影；推理劇

example: How the massive stones were brought here from hundreds of miles away is/remains a mystery.
巨石到底怎樣從幾百英里以外運到這裡來仍然是個謎。
The mystery was solved when the police discovered the murder weapon.
警方找到兇器後，謎團就解開了。
The book tries to explain some of the mysteries of life.
該書試圖解釋一些生命之謎。
The details of the scandal remain cloaked/shrouded/wrapped in mystery.
醜聞的詳情仍然不明／是一個謎／披著神秘的面紗。
It's a complete mystery (to me) that/why (= I do not understand why) she married him at all!
我完全搞不懂她怎麼會嫁給他！
I really enjoy murder mysteries.
我很愛看謀殺推理作品。
a mystery writer
偵探小說作家

NONE: › a religious play based on stories from the Bible and performed especially in Europe between the 11th and 14th centuries
神秘劇，聖史劇（尤指11至14世紀流行於歐洲的一種宗教劇，以《聖經》故事為素材）
› someone employed to test the service in shops and businesses by pretending to be a normal customer
神秘顧客（指受僱裝扮成普通顧客來檢查商店及企業服務品質的人）
› a short journey, especially with a group of other people in a bus, to visit places that are kept secret from you until you get there
（尤指許多遊客一起乘坐大客車、事先不知道目的地的）神秘旅行
› someone who attempts to be united with God through prayer
神秘主義者
› the belief that there is hidden meaning in life or that each human being can unite with God
神秘主義；通靈論
› the state of feeling very confused because someone or something is impossible to understand
迷惑不解

example: And then, to the audience's mystification, the band suddenly stopped playing.
然後，令觀眾困惑不解的是，樂隊突然停止了演奏。

NONE: › to confuse someone by being or doing something very strange or impossible to explain
使迷惑不解；使困惑

example: I was mystified by her decision.
她的決定使我迷惑不解。
Most Americans are totally mystified by the English game of cricket.
大多數美國人似乎完全搞不懂英國的板球運動是甚麼一回事。

NONE: › a quality of being special in a mysterious and attractive way
神秘氣氛；神秘性

example: There's great mystique attached to/surrounding the life of a movie star.
影星的生活都籠罩著濃厚的神秘色彩。
Too much publicity has destroyed the mystique of the British monarchy.
過多的宣傳報道破壞了英國王室的神秘感。
